name: Veður
tagline: Weather forecasts, observations, warnings and earthquakes
description: Get forecasts and the latest observations from the Icelandic Met Office for a place or address. You can also check weather warnings and recent earthquakes. No sign-in needed.
examples: Will it rain in Akureyri this afternoon?
Are there any weather warnings for the south coast today?
Have there been any earthquakes above magnitude 2 in the past 24 hours?

tools.name: now
tools.description: Latest 10-minute observation near a place, address, saved location or coordinates, or for a station/region ID

tools.name: forecast
tools.description: Hourly spot forecast (1–240 h) for a place, address, saved location, coordinates or forecast-point ID

tools.name: observations_latest
tools.description: Latest observations for a station or region at 10min/hour/day/month/year aggregation

tools.name: stations_nearest
tools.description: Select the nearest active automatic weather station to a place or coordinates

tools.name: quakes
tools.description: Recent earthquakes with time, magnitude, area and review-mode filters

tools.name: location_add
tools.description: Save a named location locally (requires confirmName)

envVars.name: VEDUR_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES
envVars.description: Set to 1 to expose the location_add/location_remove MCP tools

envVars.name: VEDUR_GEOCODER_URL
envVars.description: Alternative GeoJSON/ArcGIS address geocoder (default: Nominatim, Iceland only)

is.description: Sæktu veðurspá og nýjustu veðurathuganir frá Veðurstofu Íslands fyrir tiltekinn stað eða heimilisfang. Þú getur líka skoðað veðurviðvaranir og nýlega jarðskjálfta. Engin innskráning þarf til.
examples: Eru veðurviðvaranir á Suðurlandi í dag?
Hafa orðið jarðskjálftar yfir 2 að stærð síðasta sólarhringinn?
